Vice City, USA. The darkest side of the sunniest place in America.
Welcome to Leonida, the state where anything goes. Seize everything this massive world has to offer with the Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition, an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action around every corner.
Ultimate Edition bonuses are threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story, with new items uncovered behind each chapter.

An illustrated Vice City Leonida poster featuring characters from the hit Leonida TV show Macca the Gator on the front. Plan a road trip to every corner of the Goodtime State with a full view of the Leonida map featured on the back.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Begins on November 10
items.summary: The arrival of Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S consoles is now only a few weeks away. There’s still time to pre-order and ensure you're able to experience Grand Theft Auto VI when it launches on November 19.
items.evidence:
The arrival of Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S consoles is now only a few weeks away. There’s still time to pre-order and ensure you're able to experience Grand Theft Auto VI when it launches on November 19.
Digital pre-loading on PlayStation 5 will begin on Tuesday, November 10 at midnight local time in your respective time zone. On XBOX Series X|S, pre-loading begins globally on Tuesday, November 10 at 12 a.m. GMT. Code-in-box versions for both consoles should be available from retailers beginning November 12.
The pre-load file will require up to 212 GB depending on your device, so make sure you've got ample space to begin pre-loading as soon as possible.
For details on how to pre-load Grand Theft Auto VI for PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S, please visit the Rockstar Support site.
For more information about Grand Theft Auto VI, check out the official site to watch official videos including An Extended Look, listen to in-game radio station previews and singles from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, explore Vice City and beyond in the Only in Leonida section, and get details on the Ultimate Edition.
On November 19 we will be adding an official printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site. A double-sided physical version of this poster will also be made available shortly after launch from the Rockstar Store — for $0.99 on its own or as a free gift with any purchase from the Rockstar Store.

items.title: Pre-Load Grand Theft Auto VI Now
items.summary: Pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI digitally. Players who pre-ordered the code-in-box version can also activate their code and begin pre-loading as soon as it’s received. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19.
items.evidence:
Pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI digitally. Players who pre-ordered the code-in-box version can also activate their code and begin pre-loading as soon as it’s received. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19.
Grand Theft Auto VI has been fully developed from the ground up to provide the best possible experience for the current generation of consoles, targeting 30 frames per second while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits to bring the vast and rich world of Leonida to life — while maintaining the density and visual fidelity of all its environments and inhabitants.
The PlayStation 5 Pro offers breathtaking visuals, with improved clarity through PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) and ray-traced shadows only available on PlayStation 5 Pro.
Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 includes high-fidelity haptic feedback fully integrated across the game on DualSense controllers and adjustable via accessibility settings, improved spatial audio rendering so all in-game sounds take full advantage of Tempest 3D Audio, and improved load times, making Grand Theft Auto VI play best on PlayStation 5 consoles.
The game will also be available via XBOX Cloud Gaming on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX One consoles, utilizing XBOX Series S graphics settings. And as with all cloud streaming, connection speeds and other technical factors may influence game performance in ways that would not impact local gameplay. GTAVI will also fully support Remote Play on PlayStation and XBOX.
Check out today’s new video, featuring "Blood in Your Eyes" by Tove Lo from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album. And for more information about Grand Theft Auto VI, including links to pre-order, check out the official site.
We want to thank everyone in the community for your incredible support, and we can’t wait to see you all in Leonida on November 19.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival
items.summary: Experience the music of Vice City and Leonida at Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, a special live event on November 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami to celebrate the launch of GTAVI, featuring a star-studded lineup of artists from the game and the official soundtrack.
items.evidence:
Experience the music of Vice City and Leonida at Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, a special live event on November 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami to celebrate the launch of GTAVI, featuring a star-studded lineup of artists from the game and the official soundtrack.
Presented in partnership with PlayStation and produced by the creators of III Points, this is a one-of-a-kind launch event that features two stages of nonstop music. Performances include Cactus Jack presents Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, and Sofaygo; Cardi B; Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso; Justice (DJ set); Metro Boomin; Nick León B2B DJ Python; Prospa B2B Skream; Rauw & Friends; Suero; Tainy; The Dare B2B Fcukers (DJ set).
To enter the pre-sale lottery for a chance to purchase tickets on Wednesday, November 11, make sure you have an active DICE account with up-to-date information and visit gtavi-thefestival.miami. Tickets are limited to two per pre-sale lottery code, and the lottery closes at 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, November 10. For more information, visit rsg.ms/gtavi-thefestival.
Also, check out the Music section of the official site to learn more about in-game radio stations, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, and the Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score — with links to listen, pre-save, and pre-order on vinyl and CD.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice
items.summary: The Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score is composed by Grammy Award winners Justice, the renowned French duo of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay.
items.evidence:
The Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score is composed by Grammy Award winners Justice, the renowned French duo of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay.
Justice bring their signature sound to this adaptive score, featuring expansive compositions all dynamically tuned to the different ways players engage with the world of Vice City and Leonida throughout Jason and Lucia’s story.
Coming December 11 to all major music streaming services as well as on CD and vinyl, the official Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score album features 30 tracks, including “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard (as heard in the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer) and the new single “Pusher” feat. Gesaffelstein, debuting today. This full album also contains a number of digital bonus tracks included across all formats.
Listen to the new single, pre-save the full album, and pre-order on CD or vinyl here — including a special limited Triple Crystal Clear vinyl.
Visit the Music section of the Grand Theft Auto VI site for more, including previews of select in-game radio stations, along with featured singles from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.
